name: Thread
long_description:
Thread, a free online personal styling service for men, uses a combination of human stylists and a powerful algorithm to make it easy for guys to dress well. Thread was founded in 2012 by three guys—Kieran, Ben and Ben—who wanted to dress well, but found it difficult or frustrating to do so: they hated shopping on the High Street and were overwhelmed by millions of choices online. 

Thread combines the best bits of tech with the best bits of personal styling: After signing up by completing a short questionnaire and uploading photos of yourself, you’re paired with a stylist who reviews your information and uses Thread’s proprietary algorithm to sort through thousands of items to create the best outfits for you. When you log onto Thread, everything you see is tailored to your sizes, budget, preferences and tastes. 

We’ve raised $16 mm in funding from investors in the realms of tech, Artificial Intelligence and fashion, including Beringea, Balderton Capital, Demis Hassabis and Mustafa Suleyman (co-founders of Google-owned DeepMind), Andrew Jennings (former president of Saks 5th Avenue), Edgar Bronfman Jr. (former owner of Warner Music), Guy Hipwell (former head of online at Harrods and Liberty) and Shakil Kahn (founding investor in Spotify).
one_liner: Thread makes it incredibly easy to dress well, using stylists and AI

name: Le Tote
long_description:
Le Tote is the leading online fashion service, providing women access to an unlimited, personalized closet of everyday apparel. Its highly analytical, data-driven approach to retail aims to fundamentally transform the next generation of commerce. Leveraging more than 2B customer data points, the proprietary style and personalization engine is fully powered by algorithms, and supported by custom-built, end-to-end technology and logistics solutions.

Le Tote has customers across 48 states in the U.S. and recently launched in China. The company has seen over 300% growth year over year for the past 2 years and has raised more than $60M from top-tier venture capital firms including Andreessen Horowitz, Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Azure Capital and Sway Ventures.
one_liner: Subscription service for women's apparel & accessories.

By working on both enterprise-facing tools for design and consumer-facing tools for virtual fitting rooms, we are excited to transform visualization experiences in fashion and bring traditionally physical experiences to the virtual space. 

We are proudly backed and supported by our lead investors at Khosla Ventures and, together, we look forward to changing the way people shop and design clothing globally.

Sound like you? Find your fit at our careers page: https://www.avametric.com/careers/

launches.title: 🚀 PatternFast: AI for instantly manufacturable fashion
launches.tagline: We help fashion brands to launch collections in minutes, not months.
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/ae-nD8J-IIA>

\
\
TLDR: At PatternFast we make it quick, inexpensive and painless for fashion companies and brands to design, develop and release new styles and collections.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84021&key=user_uploads/275448/2a022106-b166-4c05-87e5-a52d71f1d398)

\
**The Problem: designing and developing fashion is very long, difficult, complex and expensive.** \
Designing and developing fashion is extremely difficult. Each step involves long and tedious work: sketching a design, creating a tech pack, drafting and fitting an initial pattern, making a sample, adjusting the pattern after fitting on a model (typically 2-3 fittings), modifying the pattern to fit specific fabrics, grading the pattern to fit all sizes, measuring each point of the pattern, making a pre-production tech pack, sewing a final sample, and finally taking pictures. The process is exceptionally complex, wasteful, expensive, and time-consuming, averaging over 92 hours per style. It costs brands $70,000 per 5 new styles on average. Some collections have more than a 1000 styles, costing brands millions of dollars and many months to complete.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84021&key=user_uploads/275448/f68e3c78-590d-4a35-acb2-db94e30b7c01)

\
\*\*The Solution: AI that assists design, product development and prepares for production; and creates photos of new fashion styles in minutes, not months.\*\*\
PatternFast helps fashion companies and brands design and launch new collections in minutes instead of months. We save brands 90% of the time and 95% of the costs associated with the tedious, time-consuming, and complex process of garment design and development. Our AI software enables the instant design of over hundred billion of unique styles, complete with production-ready documentation, patterns, and automated sizing.\
\
In just a few clicks, PatternFast creates new designs for women, men, children and teens. It also:

2. Customizes sizes for made-to-measure retail and manufacturing, and provides a full size run for mass production, based on the brand’s size run.
3. Enables smart pattern adjustments to work with any fabric, perfects fit, adds automated seam allowances, accounts for shrinkage and compression, and adjusts for stretch factor.
4. Generates a tech pack with all of the pattern measurements for each selected size.
5. AI designer creates infinite new designs based on the user input and both, unique brand’s pattern dataset, combined with billions of available patterns to mix and match.
6. AI designer creates instant color-ways and print-ways.
7. Gen-AI creates a photorealistic image of the sketch and puts it on a model for a catalog image
8. Custom API integrates with other solutions.
9. Patterns are compatible with third party solutions such as Browzwear, CLO3D, Gerber and many others.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84021&key=user_uploads/275448/ca7e5c10-8522-4e8f-a162-bbdb95fe4a9d)

name: AI.Fashion
long_description:
AI.Fashion is the AI creative suite for the fashion industry - modernizing the traditional design and go to market fashion processes with our advanced AI platform and design tools.

On the design side - our platform allows brands to create physically accurate digital versions of their unreleased clothing line before even beginning their productions processes, dramatically helping to reduce waste. 

And on the marketing side - we enable them to create photorealistic imagery of the clothing on a multitude of sizes, which creates a better experience for their customers because they have way more information about how the clothing will actually fit before they purchase.
one_liner: AI.Fashion is the AI creative suite for the fashion industry.

name: Ole
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
Ole brings fashion with delivery and return on-demand.
Customers use our app to order clothes from nearby stores, try them at home while the driver is waiting, take only what they like and return to the driver what they don't.

We already have $35k monthly GMV, growing 35% MoM.

What’s unique about our business is our average order value which is 7X higher than typical on-demand business. While their average order is $30, ours is $200, which is why we are already positive in unit economics.
